dict.string: NANOFreeDisk measures the files on your Desktop to show what uses your disk space. It never deletes anything without asking you.
NANOFreeDisk measures the files in Documents to show what uses your disk space and to find duplicates. It never deletes anything without asking you.
NANOFreeDisk measures the files in Downloads to show what uses your disk space and to find duplicates. It never deletes anything without asking you.
NANOFreeDisk measures the files on this drive to show what uses its space.
NANOFreeDisk measures the files on this network drive to show what uses its space.
